intro: Compare several metrics around a shared polar axis. RadarChart uses the same `data`, `xKey`, and `series` model as the cartesian chart entries.
useCases: Product scorecards across quality, cost, and adoption.
Team capability comparisons by skill area.
Vendor evaluation dashboards with target and current profiles.

faqs.question: Can I render multiple radar shapes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add more series entries; each `series.dataKey` draws another radar polygon against the same axis labels.

faqs.question: When should I avoid radar charts?
faqs.answer: Avoid them when exact ranking is more important than shape comparison; use bars or tables for precise ordered values.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Draws one or more filled polar shapes with optional grid, tooltip, and legend.

Appearance and density props match the rest of the chart system.

sections.heading: Data shape
sections.body: `xKey` points to the axis label field; each numeric field referenced by `series.dataKey` becomes one radar shape.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
Keep axis labels short and provide descriptive series names.

Pair with summary text when exact values matter.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import from `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/radar` inside client components when interaction is required.
